section.label: Selected Work
section.title: Projects
section.intro: A selection of work spanning web applications, developer tools, academic research, and visual projects. Each entry is labelled by category, technology, and year — not by ranking.

featured.title: LokaHub
featured.description: A community-oriented web platform built around local interaction, discovery, and shared resources. Designed and developed end-to-end with a focus on clarity and accessible interface patterns.

projects.title: Portfolio Builder
projects.description: A tool for assembling personal portfolio sites from structured content.

projects.title: Wedding Invitation Website
projects.description: Digital wedding invitation platform with RSVP and guest management.

projects.title: Laravel & PHP Packages
projects.description: Reusable packages and utilities for Laravel workflows.

projects.title: GitHub SDK Experiments
projects.description: Explorations around GitHub API integration and developer tooling.

album.title: Album Artwork Series
album.description: A series of cover artwork exploring typographic and photographic composition. The project doubles as a testing ground for visual systems that later feed back into interface work.

research.label: Research · Academic
research.title: Headless Low-Code
research.subtitle: Web Application Builder
research.description: An academic research project investigating how headless low-code architectures can be structured to support composable, decoupled web application builders. See the Research section for full context.

posters.title: Generative Posters
posters.description: A growing archive of poster compositions generated from typographic rules and modular grid systems. A space to test ideas that often become client work.
